events.title: Friday Night Shoot-Out! (Archery session)
events.source: Rogue Archery / Brisbane Archery Meetup Group
events.description: A social and active archery session where participants practice their aim in a group setting, suitable for various skill levels. This is a recurring community meetup that emphasizes learning a technical physical skill.

events.title: Brisbane BitDevs — Bitcoin Node (technical meetup)
events.description: A technical discussion group focused on the underlying systems, protocols, and development of Bitcoin. Attendees share knowledge and engage in deep-dive conversations about blockchain technology and peer-to-peer systems.

events.title: Sunday Social @ Goldie's Tavern West End
events.location: Goldie's Tavern West End, South Brisbane
events.description: A casual, low-pressure social gathering designed to connect people who are looking for local company on a Sunday. It focuses on facilitating conversation between strangers in a relaxed pub environment.

events.title: Brisbane Greeters — Greeter’s Choice guided walk
events.source: Brisbane Greeters / Brisbane City Council (What's On)
events.description: A volunteer-led guided walk through Brisbane that explores local history, architecture, and hidden city culture. It is a highly social and educational experience designed to share local knowledge with residents and visitors alike.
